title: G6 not receiving data when phone locked
body:
Using Dexcom G6 and Galaxy S9+ with Android 9.0 and xDrip+, the app receives no data after the phone has had the screen locked for a while. It *does* successfully receive data the rest of the time. Pictures and full details here:
[https://www.facebook.com/groups/cgminthecloud/permalink/2103252869795958/](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cgminthecloud/permalink/2103252869795958/)

comments.body:
Hey, I had this issue too with my S8 and a Dexcom G5 after the phone got the Android 9 update.

I updated xDrip to the nightly build from April 1 and it seems to be working with the screen lock on again.
Yeah. It totally works. Thank you! \o/
